shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200
cat package.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
(npm ci 2>&1 | tail -15) && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "ThemeProvider" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; (npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK) 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/theme/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "LangOptions" -A6 components/theme/types.d.ts | head -20; ls i18n 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "ru" i18n 2>/dev/null | head -3
cat i18n/i18n.d.ts | head -30; cat i18n/addComponentKeysets.js | head -30; cat components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -6; grep -rn "LangOptions" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3
cat components/theme/useLang.d.ts; cat components/theme/useLang.js | head -20; grep -rn "keyset\|lang" components/Select/Select.js | head -5; grep -rln "addComponentKeysets" components | head -20

cat utils/configure.d.ts; grep -n "configure" index.d.ts; grep -n "lang" utils/configure.js | head; ls components/Dialog/i18n/; cat components/Dialog/i18n/index.js | head -5; cat components/Dialog/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null

cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "view\|size" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -10; cat components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -n "ControlGroupOption" -A8 components/types.d.ts | head -30; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts | head -20
grep -rn "display-1\|header-2" components/Text/text/*.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "onUpdate" components/types.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /tmp/i18n-check && (npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 --silent 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 240 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3) ; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

(sudo -n apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 >/tmp/i18n-check/apt.log 2>&1 || (apt-get update -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 >>/tmp/i18n-check/apt.log 2>&1)); echo exit=$?; tail -3 /tmp/i18n-check/apt.log

whoami; (apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 >/tmp/i18n-check/apt2.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -2 /tmp/i18n-check/apt2.log); ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libglib-2.0.so.0 2>/dev/null; find / -name "libglib-2.0.so.0*" 2>/dev/null | head -3

sed -i '/unmount();/{n;d}' src/App.check.test.tsx && sed -i 's/^    unmount();$/    unmount();/' src/App.check.test.tsx && npx vitest run --config vitest.check.config.mts src/App.check.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -60
sed -n 1,40p src/App.check.test.tsx

rm -f src/App.check.test.tsx vitest.check.config.mts && rm -rf dist && for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -q "vite" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null && grep -q "5179" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then kill ${p#/proc/} && echo killed ${p#/proc/}; fi; done; npm ci >/tmp/i18n-check/ci.log 2>&1; echo ci_exit=$?; cmp package-lock.json /tmp/i18n-check/package-lock.json.bak && echo lock_unchanged; cmp package.json /tmp/i18n-check/package.json.bak && echo pkg_unchanged; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4; rm -rf dist; git status --short
(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5179/ || echo "port 5179 closed"); ls src/i18n; git diff --stat; wc -l src/i18n/*
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *vite*) echo "${p#/proc/}: $c";; esac; done; echo done
kill 4363 4376 4377 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"bin/vite"*) echo "still: ${p#/proc/}";; esac; done; echo checked
